title: Office and Outpatient Visit Services
body: Evaluation and management services for established patients (CPT 99213-99215) are medically necessary when supported by documented chief complaint, history, examination, and medical decision making. Prior authorization is not required for levels 99213-99214; level 99215 requires documentation review.

title: Advanced Diagnostic Imaging - MRI
body: MRI without contrast is covered when conservative therapy of at least 6 weeks has failed OR when red-flag findings are documented. MRI with contrast requires additional review of renal function documentation. Requests lacking conservative therapy documentation require prior authorization with clinical attestation.

title: Infusion Drug Administration
body: Chemotherapy and biologic infusion administration (CPT 96413, 96415) is covered in ambulatory infusion centers when the drug itself is formulary-approved. Initial administration of non-formulary agents requires prior authorization including pathology report, line of therapy, and prescriber attestation.

title: Sleep Study Studies (PSG)
body: In-lab polysomnography (CPT 95810) is covered for suspected obstructive sleep apnea when STOP-BANG score >= 3 or Epworth Sleepiness Scale >= 11 is documented, after a positive or inconclusive home sleep apnea test. Home sleep apnea testing is preferred as first-line in uncomplicated adults.

title: Physical Therapy Evaluation and Re-evaluation
body: Physical therapy evaluation (97161-97163) is covered up to 12 visits per condition per calendar year with a documented plan of care. Re-evaluation (97164) requires documented measurable change in functional status. Home-based PT requires an homebound attestation.
